channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The FBI is investigating a security breach of Vermont’s police software system, Valcour. The system was taken offline, affecting dispatch and records for many agencies. Police are using paper and radio communications during the outage.

A New York man faces up to eight thousand dollars in fines for illegally killing two bear cubs and their mother near Lake Champlain. The illegal hunting occurred along the lake's west shore. Authorities have taken action against the violations.

New York faces a potential statewide electricity shortage by twenty thirty-three due to aging power plants. The state has the oldest grid in the nation, with many facilities over seventy years old. Governor Hochul plans to build more nuclear power to keep the lights on.

Vermont State Police are looking for Shawn Burnett, wanted for multiple vehicle thefts in Chittenden and Lamoille Counties. He was last seen in Williston and is considered dangerous. Police urge anyone who sees him to call nine-one-one and not to approach him.
